# Filing the boat receipts

The Wren Lane boat share keeps its paid receipts in one folder for each kind of spending. Each receipt is one text file named `YYYY-MM-DD-supplier.txt`: the date of purchase, then the supplier in lower case with hyphens.

- `fuel/`: diesel, gas bottles and stove fuel.
- `repairs/`: parts, tools and work on the engine, hull or fittings.
- `mooring/`: berth fees, licences and lock tolls.

File a receipt whole. Do not edit its text or split it into two files.

New receipts arrive in `inbox/`, named by the scanner (`scan-0412.txt` and so on). Each moves out of `inbox/` when it is filed.
